```{r,eval=F}
# to make bed file for the pathweaver extraction and to run the seekdeep for the variant calling in those region

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# I need to update the strand for each gene and also add additional targets
regions <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "AP2MU",
    "AAT1",
    "coronin",
    "ferredoxin",
    "k13",
    "crt",
    "mdr1",
    "dhfr",
    "dhps",
    "MCA2",
    "KIC7",
    "KIC5",
    "KIC8",
    "PX1"
  ),
  coord = c(
    "Pf3D7_12_v3:716700-720700",
    "Pf3D7_06_v3:1213100-1217350",
    "Pf3D7_12_v3:2091731-2094720",
    "Pf3D7_13_v3:748160-749415",
    "Pf3D7_13_v3:1724817-1728000",
    "Pf3D7_07_v3:403000-406000",
    "Pf3D7_05_v3:957500-962000",
    "Pf3D7_04_v3:746000-751000",
    "Pf3D7_08_v3:548000-552000",
    "Pf3D7_14_v3:1548072-1557053",
    "Pf3D7_08_v3:643066-645158",
    "Pf3D7_11_v3:1525654-1532527",
    "Pf3D7_10_v3:600950-608809",
    "Pf3D7_07_v3:889883-899213"
  ),
  strand = c(
    "+",
    "-",
    "+",
    "-",
    "-",
    "+",
    "+",
    "+",
    "+",
    "+",
    "-",
    "-",
    "-",
    "+"
  )
)

bed_windows <- regions %>%
  separate(coord, into = c("chr", "pos"), sep = ":") %>%
  separate(pos, into = c("region_start", "region_end"), sep = "-") %>%
  mutate(
    region_start = as.numeric(region_start),
    region_end = as.numeric(region_end)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    windows = list(
      data.frame(
        start = seq(region_start, region_end, by = 200),
        end = pmin(seq(region_start, region_end, by = 200) + 199, region_end)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(windows) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(start = start - 1) %>% # BED format
  select(chr, start, end, name, strand) %>%
  mutate(chr_pos = paste0(chr, "-", start, "-", end)) %>%
  mutate(length = end - start) %>%
  mutate(length = as.integer(length)) %>%
  filter(length > 50) %>%
  select(chr, start, end, chr_pos, length, strand)
write.table(
  bed_windows %>% select(chr, start, end, chr_pos, length, strand),
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/hrp2_analysis/bed_file/aat1_ap2mu_co_fer_additional.bed",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)

# write.table(
#   bed_windows %>% select(chr, start, end,chr_pos, length, strand),
#   "/mnt/storage13/ahri/hrp2_analysis/bed_file/aat1_ap2mu_co_fer_additional.bed",
#   sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE
# )

write.table(
  bed_windows %>% select(chr, start, end, chr_pos, length, strand),
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/hrp2_analysis/bed_file/aat1_ap2mu_co_fer_px1_additional.bed",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r,eval=F}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

suppleme_fws <- read.csv(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/supplementary_Data/supp_fws_up.tsv",
  sep = "\t"
) %>%
  select(sample_id, Country, fws) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", sample_id)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
  select(Sample, Country, fws)

seekdeep_output_additional <- read.csv(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/seekdeep_output/pathweaveroutput_aat1_ap2mu_mca_kic/PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz",
  sep = "\t"
) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Gene = recode(Gene, "PF3D7_1251200" = "Coronin")) %>%
  #filter(Gene %in% c("Coronin","PX1","AAT1","AP2-MU","UBP1","Kelch13","CRT","PPPK-DHPS","DHFR-TS","MDR1"))%>%
  filter(AA_cnt != 0) %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Gene,
    Gene_ID,
    reference_AA_pos,
    reference_AA,
    AA,
    is_reference,
    AA_freq,
    AA_cnt
  ) %>%
  # dplyr::rename(Read = AA_cnt)
  right_join(suppleme_fws, by = "Sample")


wide_sample <- seekdeep_output_additional %>%
  mutate(
    mutation_status = ifelse(reference_AA == AA, "wildtype", "mutant"),
    mutation_test = ifelse(
      reference_AA == AA,
      paste0("0", "(", AA_freq, ")"),
      paste0(reference_AA, reference_AA_pos, AA, "(", AA_freq, ")")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, Gene, reference_AA_pos, mutation_test, Country) %>%
  group_by(Gene, reference_AA_pos, Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mutation_test = paste(unique(mutation_test), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = mutation_test,
    values_fill = "NA"
  )
readr::write_tsv(
  wide_sample,
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/seekdeep_output/pathweaveroutput_aat1_ap2mu_mca_kic/wide_sample_seekdeep_output_all_additional_variant.tsv"
)

country_n <- seekdeep_output_additional %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    total_samples = n_distinct(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Variant frequencies
allelic_freq <- seekdeep_output_additional %>%
  mutate(
    aa_change = paste0(reference_AA, ">", AA)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Country,
    Gene,
    reference_AA_pos,
    aa_change,
    is_reference
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n_distinct(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(country_n, by = "Country") %>%
  filter(is_reference == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    freq = n_samples / total_samples,
    freq_label = paste0(
      round(freq, 3),
      " (",
      n_samples,
      "/",
      total_samples,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Gene,
    reference_AA_pos,
    aa_change,
    Country,
    freq_label
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Country,
    values_from = freq_label,
    values_fill = "0 (0/0)"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Gene, reference_AA_pos)

readr::write_tsv(
  allelic_freq,
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/seekdeep_output/pathweaveroutput_aat1_ap2mu_mca_kic/wide_sample_seekdeep_output_all_additional_variant_allel_freq.tsv"
)
```

```{r,eval=F}
wide_sample_tes <- seekdeep_output_tes %>%
  mutate(
    mutation_status = ifelse(reference_AA == AA, "wildtype", "mutant"),
    mutation_test = ifelse(
```

```{r,eval=F}
AC091_comparision <- wide_sample_tes %>%
  select(Gene, reference_AA_pos, AC091_D21, AC091_TF) %>%
  mutate(
    compare = ifelse(
      !is.na(AC091_TF) & !is.na(AC091_D21),
      ifelse(AC091_D21 == AC091_TF, "match", "mismatch"),
      "NA"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(compare == "mismatch")
readr::write_tsv(
  wide_sample_tes,
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/seekdeep_output/pathweaver_Tes_samples/wide_sample_filtered_region_interest_px1_AA_freq.tsv"
)

# association of px1 varaints and k13 622 for the TES samples

px1_k13 <- seekdeep_output_tes %>%
  filter(
    Gene %in% c("PX1", "Kelch13"),
    reference_AA_pos %in% c("1222", "1701", "1705", "622")
  )

#print(length(unique(wide_sample_tes$Sample)))

haplotypes_px1 <- px1_k13 %>%
  filter(reference_AA_pos %in% c("1222", "1701", "1705")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    haplotype = paste(
      AA[match(c("1222", "1701", "1705"), reference_AA_pos)],
      collapse = "/"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(metadata_tes, by = "Sample")
haplotype_k13 <- px1_k13 %>%
  filter(reference_AA_pos == "622") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    haplotype = paste(
      AA[match("622", reference_AA_pos)],
      collapse = "/"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

join_px1_k13 <- haplotypes_px1 %>%
  left_join(haplotype_k13, by = "Sample", suffix = c("_px1", "_k13")) %>%
  mutate(
    association = ifelse(
      !is.na(haplotype_px1) & !is.na(haplotype_k13),
      paste0("PX1:", haplotype_px1, " - K13:", haplotype_k13),
      "NA"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, association) %>%
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      grepl("MM", Sample) ~ "Mizan",
      grepl("GM", Sample) ~ "Gondar",
      grepl("AC", Sample) ~ "Gambella"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, association) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

readr::write_tsv(
  join_px1_k13,
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/seekdeep_output/pathweaver_Tes_samples/join_px1_k13_TES.tsv"
)
```

```{r}
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-", "_", Sample)) %>%
  select(-sample)
seekdeep_output_tes_1 <- read.csv(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/seekdeep_output/pathweaver_Tes_samples_px1_additional_pfcarl/PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz",
  sep = "\t"
) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-", "_", Sample)) %>%
  #right_join(metadata_tes, by = "Sample")%>%
  mutate(Gene = recode(Gene, "PF3D7_1251200" = "Coronin")) %>%
  # filter(Gene %in% c("Coronin","PX1","AAT1","AP2-MU","UBP1","Kelch13","CRT","PPPK-DHPS","DHFR-TS","MDR1","PFcarl"))%>%
  filter(AA_cnt != 0) %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Gene,
    Gene_ID,
    reference_AA_pos,
    reference_AA,
    AA,
    is_reference,
    AA_freq,
    AA_cnt
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Read = AA_cnt)
print(colnames(seekdeep_output_tes))

wide_sample_tes <- seekdeep_output_tes_1 %>%
  mutate(
    mutation_status = ifelse(reference_AA == AA, "wildtype", "mutant"),
    mutation_test = ifelse(
      reference_AA == AA,
      paste0("0", "(", AA_freq, ")"),
      paste0(reference_AA, reference_AA_pos, AA, "(", AA_freq, ")")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, Gene, reference_AA_pos, mutation_test) %>%
  group_by(Gene, reference_AA_pos, Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mutation_test = paste(unique(mutation_test), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
    
  # pivot_wider(
  #   names_from = Sample,
  #   values_from = mutation_test,
  #   values_fill = "NA"
  # )
  filter(!Sample %in% failed_samples$sample) %>%
  left_join(metadata_tes, by = "Sample")


totals <- wide_sample_tes %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(total_samples = n_distinct(Sample))

# Mutation frequencies
allele_freq <- wide_sample_tes %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Gene, reference_AA_pos, mutation_test) %>%
  summarise(mutant_samples = n_distinct(Sample), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(totals, by = "Treatment") %>%
  mutate(allele_frequency = mutant_samples / total_samples) %>%
  filter(mutation_test != "0(1)", allele_frequency > 0.1)


library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
allele_freq %>% filter(Gene == "PX1",
reference_AA_pos %in% c("1222", "1701", "1705")),
aes(
  x = Treatment,
 y = mutation_test,
 size = mutant_samples,
  color = mutant_samples ) ) +
 geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal()


library(viridis)





my_plot <- ggplot(allele_freq, aes(Treatment, mutation_test, fill = mutant_samples)) +

  geom_tile(color = "grey95") +

  geom_text(aes(label = mutant_samples), size = 3, color = "white") +

  facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D") +

  labs(

    x = "",
    y = "Mutation",

  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),

  )

ggsave(filename = "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/whole_genome_scripts/genotype_extraction/tes_allgenotype_report_plot.pdf", 
       plot = my_plot, 
       width = 10, 
       height = 10, 
       units = "in", 
       dpi = 300)

px1_target <- wide_sample_tes%>%
  filter(Gene == "PX1", reference_AA_pos %in% c("1222", "1701", "1705")) %>%
  select(Sample, Gene, reference_AA_pos, mutation_test, Treatment) %>%
  # pivot_wider(names_from = reference_AA_pos, values_from = mutation_test) %>%
  mutate(
    mutation = case_when(
      grepl("D1705N", mutation_test) ~ "D1705N",
      grepl("1222", mutation_test) ~ "L1705P",
      grepl("1701", mutation_test) ~ "M1701I",
      TRUE ~ "WT"
    )
  )%>%
  select(-mutation_test)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = reference_AA_pos, values_from = mutation) %>%

  mutate(haplotype = paste(`1222`, `1701`, `1705`, sep = "/")) %>%
  select(Sample, haplotype, Treatment)%>%
  left_join(totals, by = "Treatment") %>%
  group_by(Treatment, haplotype,total_samples) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")%>%
  mutate(freq = count / total_samples)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scales)

# Consistent treatment colors
treat_cols <- c(
  Ts  = "#009E73",   # Green
  Tf0 = "#E69F00",   # Orange
  Tf  = "#0072B2"    # Blue
)


p1 <- ggplot(px1_target,
       aes(x = Treatment,
           y = reorder(haplotype, freq),
           fill = freq)) +

  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +

  geom_text(aes(label = count),
            color = "blue",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 4) +

  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    name = "Frequency"  ) +

  labs(
    title = "PX1 Haplotype Frequencies",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Haplotype"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


p2 <- ggplot(px1_target,
       aes(Treatment, haplotype)) +

  geom_point(aes(size = count,
                 fill = Treatment),
             shape = 21,
             color = "black",
             stroke = 0.3,
             alpha = 0.9) +

  geom_text(aes(label = count),
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 3.8) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = treat_cols) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(5, 18),
    name = "Count"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "PX1 Haplotype Counts",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Haplotype",
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p3 <- ggplot(px1_target,
       aes(haplotype,
           freq,
           fill = Treatment)) +

  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
           width = 0.7,
           color = "black",
           linewidth = 0.2) +

  geom_text(aes(label = count),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.3,
            size = 3.8,
            fontface = "bold") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = treat_cols) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "PX1 Haplotype Frequencies",
    x = "Haplotype",
    y = "Frequency",
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                               hjust = 1,
                               face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

library(patchwork)

combined_plot <- (p1 | p2) /
                 p3 +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "PX1 Haplotype Analysis",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18,
                                face = "bold",
                                hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

combined_plot

ggsave(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/whole_genome_scripts/genotype_extraction/PX1_haplotype_plots.pdf",

)
```
